December 2018: Islamabad, Pakistan

The popular Russian diplomats [Boris and Juri](http://cdn.collider.com/wp-content/uploads/dumb-and-dumber-sequel-jim-carrey.jpeg) have been deployed to Islamabad to continue discussions of the Russian sales of military equipment to the country of Pakistan. Boris was unfortunately tired after a [long night of diplomatic debates with an unknown source](http://www.lcbo.com/content/dam/lcbo/products/137117.jpg/jcr:content/renditions/cq5dam.web.1280.1280.jpeg), so Juri will be headlining the discussions with the Pakistanis today. The Pakistani Minister of Defense, [Khawaja Muhammad Asif](http://www.dnd.com.pk/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Khwaja-Asif21.gif) requested that this meeting take place at the [Embassy of the Russian Federation in the Islamic Republic of Pakistan](http://pakistan.mid.ru/web/pakistan_en). Boris' [took a nap on his favorite couch in the embassy](https://i.kinja-img.com/gawker-media/image/upload/s--WYekdDQZ--/788310571993490214.jpg) before Minister Asif arrived. "??? ???????? ?? ??????? ????", Boris mumbled incoherently.

Luckily Minister Asif was 3 hours late due to 'Issues relating to National Security', so Boris was well rested for the meeting.

[All have arrived at the embassy for the meeting](https://veuwer.com/i/3t7s.jpg) and discussions have begun. Following the landmark sale of [4 Mi-35 Helicopters to Pakistan last year](http://www.dawn.com/news/1201473), Russia proposes continuing to improve our [former relationship with Pakistan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pakistan%E2%80%93Russia_relations#Fall_of_Communism_and_the_21st_century). We want to propose the following upcoming trade deals:

* Russia will sell Pakistan 12 [Sukhoi Su-35 fighter jets](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sukhoi_Su-35). This was a [previously discussed deal](https://www.quora.com/What-do-you-make-out-of-Pakistan-getting-Su-35-from-Russia), but the fighter jets were never officially sold. The cost of these jets would be estimated around [$1 billion dollars](http://www.dawn.com/news/1220802). * Russia is interested in joining [CPEC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/China%E2%80%93Pakistan_Economic_Corridor), which will benefit CPEC and strengthen Pakistan's economy. [This has been previously debated](http://defence.pk/threads/russia-may-join-pakistan-china-economic-corridor-cpec-project.381529/) and we think this will benefit all 3 nations economically. * Russia will continue monitoring and funding the construction of the [North-South gas pipeline](http://www.dawn.com/news/1213460), which is slated to be completed in 2020. We will cover the majority of costs if this pipeline has any delays or geographical issues. * We would like to increase our bilateral trade benefits by approximately 10% over the next 5 years. We would like to stress increasing the Russian import of [Pakistan's world-leading dairy exports](http://www.dawn.com/news/1155375) to benefit our country.
